title: Product review / demo (TikTok Shop), possibly with BEFORE/AFTER
summary: A product shown working: hook with the result, the problem, the demo, the reveal, the cart. Built on 16,242 measured TikTok Shop videos; its house style is 3-4 s scenes, soft transitions, no text in boxes.
signals: hands and the product in close-up, tabletop or top-down
a visible process with a result (stain, mess, skin, surface)
voice recorded separately (or to be synthesized)

runtime.why: In the reference dataset sub-25 s product videos had the lowest CTR and sale rate of any band (references/niche-winning-patterns.md).

hook.purpose: BEFORE → AFTER of the same item, joined by a wipe

structure.purpose: make the stake concrete: name the item and the problem
structure.graphics: title, thumbs when the voice lists three
title stack + punch on the product name

structure.purpose: pay off the hook; same framing as the BEFORE; no hidden cut
repeat concretely, point at the real cart

music.mood: light, upbeat bed far under the voice; Commercial Music Library or none

compliance: No absolute superlative (own-sales claims are permitted)
No competitor comparison, no false scarcity
Before/after: same item, same framing, same light and the SAME grade; time compression labelled on screen
Staged problems (a mark made on purpose) labelled as a test on screen
No fake UI: the CTA points at the real product bar
Video will be boosted as an ad? Then no before/after comparison (ask the user)
Commercial-content disclosure switched on at upload; music from the Commercial Music Library or original audio

unboxing.about: First impression: the box, the reveal of the product, three details, the verdict.

hook.purpose: the most surprising detail or the product in hand first, then the closed box

structure.purpose: the package, the seal, what is in it
the product comes out: hold the take
three details in macro, one per scene

listicle.about: Top-N or one-by-one of the shop's OWN products (TikTok Shop forbids comparing against competitors).

structure.purpose: one item per beat: name, the one reason, the proof shot
the winner again and the cart
